type U = {kind: "s", f: (x: string) => void} | {kind: "n", f: (x: number) => void};
const tag = "s";
const a: U = {kind: tag, f: x => console.log(x.toUpperCase())};
a.f("a");
const kind = "s";
const b: U = {kind, f: x => console.log(x.toUpperCase())};
b.f("b");
const tags = {kind: "s" as const};
const c: U = {kind: tags.kind, f: x => console.log(x.toUpperCase())};
c.f("c");
const d: U = {kind: ((tag)), f: x => console.log(x.toUpperCase())};
d.f("d");
let known: "s" | "n" = "s";
const e: U = {kind: known, f: x => console.log(x.toUpperCase())};
e.f("e");
